feature: Measured CPU, memory and disk charts and grouping
entry_point: Account menu → Operations; /operations → measured usage charts
steps: With measured_visible enabled in a local fixture or already enabled deployment, inspect all three metrics.
Select Total, By owner and By Sandbox; inspect coverage, source health and unknown mappings.
expected_result: Measured values remain separate from allocated billing quantities; missing coverage is not presented as zero and series retain report identity.

feature: Sandbox usage details and owner drill-down
entry_point: Account menu → Operations; /operations → usage row → details
steps: Open a row and inspect status, runtime image, allocated capacity and period totals.
Inspect measured series where enabled; choose View this owner’s usage and return.
expected_result: Detail belongs to the selected report and Sandbox; owner drill-down changes the authorized owner scope and does not leak a previous principal’s report.

entry_point: Account menu → Operations; /operations → Sandbox usage details → Lifecycle history
steps: Open lifecycle history for an owned and a locally created other-owner Sandbox.
Traverse Next and First history page; close/reopen after an injected local failure.
expected_result: Authorized intervals display time, resource allocation and duration; cross-owner permission is checked on the existing non-admin history route.

feature: Infrastructure diagnostics excluded from owner usage
entry_point: Account menu → Operations; /operations → measured report → Infrastructure diagnostics
steps: Expand the diagnostics in an admin report with infrastructure data.
Inspect unassigned pool, unattributed resources, observation time and unproven identities.
expected_result: Infrastructure quantities are labelled and excluded from owner totals; no unavailable metric is invented.

entry_point: SDK adminUsageMetrics.owners; no dedicated current Operations control
steps: Create a completed admin report locally or reuse an authorized report.
Query owners by search with bounded cursor pagination on both AMs.
expected_result: Owner pages remain tied to the report, authorized principal and complete frozen cohort.
